description: The middle branch of frame_duration_seconds: a state declaring no fps is timed by the delays the source file carries. frame_delays.gif holds 40/120/80/200ms across its four frames, and animation.frames indexes them out of order (0,3,1,2) so a lookup that ignored the atlas index would land on the wrong duration. dt 0.013 keeps every boundary at least 1ms away from a step, since f32 and f64 land either side of an exact one.
